overview: The period mixes agentic and LLM-driven calibration/observing workflows with simulation-based inference: normalizing flows for DESI photo-z and gravitational-wave cosmology, neural operators and surrogates for MHD turbulence, waveforms and stellar structure. New benchmarks target cross-survey imputation and small-data image classifiers, while catalogues include Fermi-LAT sources, SUMSS position angles and a 10.13-million-star spectroscopic homogenisation.
